observations: Four used tires photographed outdoors on bare concrete/asphalt ground.
Tires are stacked/leaning against each other, sidewalls angled away from camera.
Tread shows moderate wear with grooves still visible, but exact depth cannot be measured from the photo.
No brand name, size code, or DOT date stamp is legible on any sidewall in the photo.
A watermark 'GF GLOBAL POSTED ON JIJI' overlays the image; this is the lister's stamp, not product information.
Background shows a shop/yard setting with other tires and a vehicle fender, consistent with a tire resale yard.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows worn tires but condition grading ('good quality') cannot be confirmed without close-up of tread depth and sidewall integrity.
No Michelin logo or lettering is legible anywhere on the sidewalls in photo 0.

risks.proof: Close-up photo of sidewall showing the size code (e.g., 205/55R16)
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all, since tire value is driven mainly by size

risks.risk: Brand cannot be confirmed as Michelin
risks.if_unproven: priced as unbranded/generic used tire, not premium brand

risks.risk: Tread depth and wear level unknown precisely
risks.proof: Close-up photo of tread with a depth gauge or coin for scale
risks.if_unproven: priced as low/minimum tread (near legal limit)

risks.proof: Photo of DOT date code on sidewall
risks.if_unproven: priced as old stock (assume aged beyond ideal range)

risks.risk: Hidden sidewall damage, bulges, or repair patches
risks.proof: Photos of each tire's full sidewall and inner surface
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming possible hidden damage, i.e., lowest condition tier

proof_requests: Close-up photo of one tire's sidewall showing size code, brand name, and DOT date stamp
Photo of tread depth with a coin or gauge for scale
Photos of each tire's full sidewall (inner and outer) for cracks or repairs
response.reason: Neither the tire size nor the brand can be read from the single photo, and both are essential to set even a worst-case price for tires.
